23458-little-journeys-to-the-homes-of-th.title: Little Journeys to the Homes of Great Lovers
23458-little-journeys-to-the-homes-of-th.creator: Elbert Hubbard
23458-little-journeys-to-the-homes-of-th.description: A book by Elbert Hubbard. Bearing on the same line we have the legend that the adage, "He laughs best who laughs last," was the invention of a Scotchman who was endeavoring to explain away a popular failing of his countrymen.

arxiv-1711-09423.title: Bipolar comparison
arxiv-1711-09423.creator: Nina Lebedeva, Anton Petrunin, Vladimir Zolotov
arxiv-1711-09423.description: Abstract We define a new type of metric comparison similar to the comparison of Alexandrov. We show that it has strong connections to continuity of optimal transport between regular measures on a Riemannian manifold, in particular to the so called MTW condition introduced by Xi-Nan Ma, Neil Trudinger and Xu-Jia Wang.

arxiv-2012-00991.title: ProsRegNet: A Deep Learning Framework for Registration of MRI and Histopathology Images of the Prostate
arxiv-2012-00991.creator: Wei Shao, Linda Banh, Christian A. Kunder, Richard E. Fan, Simon J. C. Soerensen, Jeffrey B. Wang, Nikola C. Teslovich, Nikhil Madhuripan, Anugayathri Jawahar, Pejman Ghanouni, James D. Brooks, Geoffrey A. Sonn, Mirabela Rusu
arxiv-2012-00991.description: Abstract Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is an increasingly important tool for the diagnosis and treatment of prostate cancer. However, interpretation of MRI suffers from high inter-observer variability across radiologists, thereby contributing to missed clinically significant cancers, overdiagnosed low-risk cancers, and frequent false positives.

arxiv-2104-11351.title: Towards Automated Acceptance testing for industrial robots
arxiv-2104-11351.creator: Marcela G. dos Santos, Fabio Petrillo
arxiv-2104-11351.description: Abstract Industrial robots are important machines applied in numerous modern industries that execute repetitive tasks with high accuracy, replacing or supporting dangerous jobs. In this kind of system, with increased complexity in which cost is related to the time the system keeps working, the system must operate with a minimum number of failures.

arxiv-2109-03872.title: Inverse Laplace Transformation Analysis of Stretched Exponential Relaxation Journal: Journal of Magnetic Resonance
arxiv-2109-03872.creator: H. Choi, I. Vinograd, C. Chaffey, N. J. Curro
arxiv-2109-03872.description: Abstract We investigate the effectiveness of the Inverse Laplace Transform (ILT) analysis method to extract the distribution of relaxation rates from nuclear magnetic resonance data with stretched exponential relaxation. Stretched-relaxation is a hallmark of a distribution of relaxation rates, and an analytical expression exists for this distribution for the case of a spin-1/2 nucleus.

arxiv-2303-04257.title: adaPARL : Adaptive Privacy-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Sequential-Decision Making Human-in-the-Loop Systems Conference: International Conference on Internet-of-Things Design and Implementation; May 9–12, 2023; San Antonio, TX, USA International Conference on Internet-of-Things Design and Implem
arxiv-2303-04257.creator: Mojtaba Taherisadr, Stelios Andrew Stavroulakis, Salma Elmalaki
arxiv-2303-04257.description: Abstract . Reinforcement learning (RL) presents numerous benefits compared to rule-based approaches in various applications. Privacy concerns have grown with the widespread use of RL trained with privacy-sensitive data in IoT devices, especially for human-in-the-loop systems. On the one hand, RL methods enhance the user experience by trying to adapt to the highly dynamic nature of humans.

arxiv-2305-03081.title: Minimal model for the W W -boson mass, ( g − 2 ) μ (g-2)_{\mu} , h → μ + ​ μ − h\to\mu^{+}\mu^{-} and quark-mixing-matrix unitarity Preprint: PSI-PR-23-11, ZU-TH 20/23
arxiv-2305-03081.creator: Andreas Crivellin, Matthew Kirk, Anil Thapa
arxiv-2305-03081.description: Abstract The S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) L SU(2)_{L} triplet scalar with hypercharge Y = 0 Y=0 predicts a positive definite shift in the W W mass, w.r.t. the Standard Model prediction, if it acquires a vacuum expectation value.

arxiv-2307-09500.title: Exact hole-induced S ​ U ​ ( N ) SU(N) flavor-singlets in certain U = ∞ U=\infty S ​ U ​ ( N ) SU(N) Hubbard models
arxiv-2307-09500.creator: Kyung-Su Kim (김경수), Hosho Katsura ( {CJK*} UTF8ipxm桂法称)
arxiv-2307-09500.description: Abstract We prove that the motion of a single hole induces S ​ U ​ ( N ) SU(N) flavor singlets in the U = ∞ U=\infty S ​ U ​ ( N ) SU(N) (Fermi) Hubbard model on a Husimi-like tree graph.

arxiv-2309-04400.title: Global monopoles in the two-Higgs-doublet-model
arxiv-2309-04400.creator: Richard A. Battye, Steven J. Cotterill and Dominic G. Viatic
arxiv-2309-04400.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Richard A. Battye, Steven J. Cotterill and Dominic G. Viatic. We discuss monopoles formed due to the spontaneous breakdown of a global S ​ O ​ ( 3 ) HF SO(3)_{\rm HF} symmetry within the global two-Higgs doublet model.

arxiv-2309-12788.title: Investigating high redshift short GRBs: signatures of collapsars?
arxiv-2309-12788.creator: Dimple, Kuntal, Lallan
arxiv-2309-12788.description: Abstract The conventional classification of Gamma-Ray Bursts (GRBs) as short or long bursts based on their duration is widely accepted as arising from different progenitor sources identified as compact object mergers and collapsars, respectively. However, recent observational shreds of evidence challenged this view, with signatures of collapsars in short GRBs and mergers in long GRBs.

arxiv-2311-04982.title: Legacy Analysis of Dark Matter Annihilation from the Milky Way Dwarf Spheroidal Galaxies with 14 Years of Fermi -LAT Data
arxiv-2311-04982.creator: Alex McDaniel, Marco Ajello, Christopher M. Karwin, Mattia Di Mauro, Alex Drlica-Wagner, Miguel Sànchez-Conde
arxiv-2311-04982.description: Abstract The Milky Way dwarf spheroidal satellite galaxies (dSphs) are particularly intriguing targets to search for gamma rays from Weakly Interacting Massive Particle (WIMP) dark matter (DM) annihilation or decay. They are nearby, DM-dominated, and lack significant emission from standard astrophysical processes.

arxiv-2312-09821.title: Fragility, Robustness and Antifragility in Deep Learning
arxiv-2312-09821.creator: Chandresh Pravin, Ivan Martino, Giuseppe Nicosia, Varun Ojha
arxiv-2312-09821.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Chandresh Pravin, Ivan Martino, Giuseppe Nicosia, Varun Ojha. We propose a systematic analysis of deep neural networks (DNNs) based on a signal processing technique for network parameter removal, in the form of synaptic filters that identifies the fragility , robustness and antifragility characteristics of DNN parameters. Our proposed analysis investigates if the DNN performance is impacted negatively, invariantly, or positively on both clean and adversarially perturbed test datasets when the DNN undergoes synaptic filtering.

arxiv-2412-19777.title: Application of normalizing flows to nuclear many-body perturbation theory
arxiv-2412-19777.creator: Pengsheng Wen, Jeremy W. Holt, Albany Blackburn
arxiv-2412-19777.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Pengsheng Wen, Jeremy W. Holt, Albany Blackburn. Many-body perturbation theory provides a powerful framework to study the ground state and thermodynamic properties of nuclear matter as well as associated single-particle potentials and response functions within a systematic order-by-order expansion. However, computational challenges can emerge beyond the lowest orders of perturbation theory, especially when computing both single-particle potentials and response functions, which in general are complex-valued and require Cauchy principal value calculations of high-dimensional integrals.

arxiv-2504-11067.title: Morphing-based Compression for Data-centric ML Pipelines
arxiv-2504-11067.creator: Sebastian Baunsgaard, Matthias Boehm
arxiv-2504-11067.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sebastian Baunsgaard, Matthias Boehm. Data-centric ML pipelines extend traditional machine learning (ML) pipelines—of feature transformations and ML model training—by outer loops for data cleaning, augmentation, and feature engineering to create high-quality input data. Existing lossless matrix compression applies lightweight compression schemes to numeric matrices and performs linear algebra operations such as matrix-vector multiplications directly on the compressed representation but struggles to efficiently rediscover structural data redundancy.

pmc-10633899.title: Green chromatographic methods for determination of co-formulated lidocaine hydrochloride and miconazole nitrate along with an endocrine disruptor preservative and potential impurity
pmc-10633899.creator: Esraa S. Ashour, Maha A. Hegazy, Amal M. Abou Al-Alamein, Ghada M. El-Sayed, Nermine S. Ghoniem
pmc-10633899.description: Recently, green analytical chemistry (GAC) is a key issue towards the idea of sustainability, the analytical community is focused on developing analytical methods that incorporate green chemistry principles to minimize adverse impacts on the environment and humans. Herein, we present 2 sustainable, selective, and validated chromatographic methods.

pmc-11341001.title: Using Design Thinking to Understand the Reason for Headache Referrals and Reduce Referral Rates
pmc-11341001.creator: Ashish D. Patel, Mallory Sponenberg, Leeann Webster, Sara Cole, Edward Stefanowicz, Jason A. Dinko, Brian Seeley, Scott Friedenberg
pmc-11341001.description: BackgroundThe demand for neurology services exceeds the current supply. We convened multiple stakeholders to learn what drives our primary care providers (PCPs) to refer patients with headache to our neurology practice. This information guided a collaborative effort to evaluate the impact of an electronic health record (EHR) headache tool on care delivery in our PCP clinics.

pmc-11350689.title: A Functional 67-bp Duplication Locating at the Core Promoter Region within the Bovine ADIPOQ Gene Is Associated with Ovarian Traits and mRNA Expression
pmc-11350689.creator: Yufu Li, Tingting Liu, Mengyang Zhang, Chuanying Pan, Xu Liu, Haiyu Zhao, Xianyong Lan
pmc-11350689.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryOur previous investigation identified a 67-bp variable duplication in the ADIPOQ promoter region, which may impact cow ovarian development. Our researchers looked into the relationship between ADIPOQ promoter variants and ovarian traits and mRNA expression in Chinese Holstein cows in order to gain a better understanding of how to maximize the milk production of these cows while preserving their reproductive efficiency. Three genotypes were found in 2219 samples, and there was a strong correlation between this mutation and ovarian traits.

pmc-11498716.title: Temperature Dependence of Reaction Kinetics in a Hybrid GaAs Solar–Fuel Cell Device
pmc-11498716.creator: Mahdi Alizadeh, Shengyang Li, Seyed Ahmad Shahahmadi, Jani Oksanen
pmc-11498716.description: The recently proposed single-electrode fuel cell (SEFC) is based on the chemovoltaic effect in a semiconductor p–n junction and as a hybrid device also allows operation as a photovoltaic cell. This study investigates the temperature dependence of the chemovoltaic effect in GaAs/GaInP p–n double heterojunction SEFC devices in the presence of both liquid and vapor methanol as a fuel.

pmc-11673919.title: 3D-Printed Self-Assembling Helical Models for Exploring Viral Capsid Structures
pmc-11673919.creator: Donald Plante, Keegan Unzen, John R. Jungck
pmc-11673919.description: This work presents a novel application of additive manufacturing in the design of self-assembling helical viral capsids using 3D-printed components. Expanding on prior work with 3D-printed self-assembling spherical capsids, we developed helical models that integrate geometric parameters and magnetic interactions to mimic key features of the assembly process of helical viral capsids.

pmc-13551974.title: CBCT evaluation of bone thickness in nasomaxillary and zygomaticomaxillary buttresses for Le Fort I osteotomy in UCLP patients
pmc-13551974.creator: Yunus Çetiner, Duygu Çelik Özen, İrfan Üstündağ, Elif Begüm Yiğit Çetiner, Şuayip Burak Duman, Bahadır Sancar
pmc-13551974.description: BackgroundCleft lip and palate (CLP) is one of the most common congenital anomalies affecting the craniofacial skeleton and is frequently associated with maxillary hypoplasia and midface deficiency. In these patients, orthognathic surgery—particularly Le Fort I osteotomy—constitutes a critical step in treatment. However, postoperative stability may be influenced by anatomical variations in the maxillary buttress regions.
